655.61 Speed camera. This sign indicates that an automatic speed camera, which may photograph a traffic offence, is ahead.

655.62 Average speed check. This sign indicates that a stretch of road is ahead where automatic speed cameras measure the average speed of a vehicle, that is the speed at which the vehicle travels on average over a given distance.
655.71 Surveillance camera. This sign indicates that at the location or on the stretch of road there is an automatic surveillance camera monitoring traffic.
656 Speed limit information. This sign gives information on the general traffic law rules on the permitted maximum speed in different conditions.

658.1 Recommended route for a type of traffic. This sign indicates the recommended route for the type of traffic specified on the sign. The sign is varied according to the type of traffic, e.g. goods vehicles, cyclists, traffic of disabled road users and horse riders. Other traffic is permitted unless a ban is specifically imposed on it.
